'New template from a starter: Photo required if Not OK is off

''Photo required if Not OK' changed from on (22 Sep Key Decision: on by default for newly created templates) to off, starters included (S17-R2). No case opens a starter and reads the photo option: the existing cases check it only on a checkbox field added by hand. Note required was already on for starters on 22 Sep (same Key Decision); v43 only adds the words "starters included", so step 4 is an unchanged-behaviour check, not a change.

'S17-R2: between 29 Sep 2026 and 2 Oct 2026 (Not named in the change log; Jira SV-10789 (2 Oct 2026) already quotes the new text)
SV-9440: 2 Oct 2026 (Story description rewritten from 'On by default' to 'OFF by default' by Milos Vasic (PM); SV-10789 (Viktoria Videnovic, 2 Oct; fixed 5 Oct) is the defect history, not the decision)
S1-R2: between 29 Sep 2026 and 13 Oct 2026 (Clarification only - the 22 Sep Key Decision already made it on by default for newly created templates (starters are newly created templates); kept as an unchanged-behaviour check)

'You are signed in on a desktop as a user with 'Settings - Service'.
The starter templates are offered when you create a new template (for example Air-Brake Inspection and Trailer Inspection).

'1. Go to Settings > Inspection Templates and create a new template.
2. Choose to start from a template and pick a starter (for example Air-Brake Inspection).
3. Select a checkbox field that came with the starter.
4. Read the 'Note required if Monitor / Not OK' option in its properties.
5. Read the 'Photo required if Not OK' option in its properties.
6. Create another new template from a different starter (for example Trailer Inspection) and repeat steps 3 to 5.

'Step 4: 'Note required if Monitor / Not OK' is on for the starter's checkbox field.
Step 5: 'Photo required if Not OK' is off for the starter's checkbox field.
Step 6: the second starter's checkbox field shows the same: 'Note required if Monitor / Not OK' on and 'Photo required if Not OK' off.
=HYPERLINK("https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/88507","C88507")

'Verdict FIX, every correction applied: justified by the photo default only (S17-R2, product decision SV-9440 by Milos Vasic, 2 Oct); the note check (step 4) is kept as an unchanged-behaviour check, labelled as a clarification and not a change. Hand-added checkbox fields are already covered by C88507 and C88510; this test covers only fields that come with a starter. Always start a brand-new template: templates saved before the 5 Oct fix keep the setting they were saved with (SV-10789).
'Completing a reopened inspection again gives the report a new inspected date

'New in the spec: the inspected date is the first completion date and only reopening and completing again gives a new date; the updated regenerate case checks that regenerating keeps the date, but nothing checks that completing again changes it.
'S13-R14: 5 Oct 2026 (Developer and QA questions answered)

'You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - View'.
A completed inspection on an open work order, with its report, first completed at least one day before you run this test (for example yesterday). A completion date cannot be set by hand, so the inspection must be completed on an earlier day.

'1. Open the inspection's report and note the inspected date.
2. Open the completed inspection and reopen it.
3. Change one answer.
4. Press 'Submit & Generate Report' and finish the sign-off.
5. Open the newest report from the inspection report note on the work order.
6. Read the inspected date.

'Step 1: the inspected date is the day the inspection was first completed (for example yesterday).
Step 6: the newest report shows today's date as the inspected date, so it can be told apart from the earlier version.
=HYPERLINK("https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/88575","C88575")

'Verdict KEEP. Small note applied: the inspection must be completed at least a day before the run, because a tester cannot back-date a completion. The reopen-gives-new-date half may be how the product already behaved, but it was never written down before 5 Oct, so it is a spec addition with no case. No ShopCoach needed.
'Changing or merging the asset does not regenerate the inspection report

'The PM decided on 8 Oct, after the spec, that an asset change or merge never regenerates existing reports and that a manual regenerate takes the work order's current asset with the inspected date unchanged; this is not yet in the PRD and no case checks it, so a build that silently regenerates would pass.

'SV-10960: 8 Oct 2026 (Milos Vasic (PM) in Jira; not yet in PRD v43 ('I'll add this to the PRD'))
S13-R14: 5 Oct 2026 (Developer and QA questions answered (the inspected date the PM's ruling refers to))

'You are signed in with 'Work orders - Create & Edit' and 'Customers - View', and you can edit the customer's assets.
You can regenerate an inspection report. No source names the regenerate control or the role that grants it: read both off the build and write them here before running.
A customer with three assets: asset A (for example unit 1001), asset B (for example unit 2002) and asset C (for example unit 3003). Asset C has a VIN; write it down.
An open work order on asset A with a completed inspection and its report, first completed at least one day before you run this test (for example yesterday).

'1. Open the report from the inspection report note on the work order and note the asset and the inspected date it shows.
2. On the work order, change the asset from asset A to asset B and save.
3. Open the report from the inspection report note again.
4. Regenerate the report.
5. Open the report from the inspection report note.
6. Open asset B, change its VIN to asset C's VIN, save, and answer Yes to 'Would you like to merge with the already existing asset?'.
7. Open the report from the inspection report note again.

'Step 1: the report shows asset A and the inspected date (for example yesterday's date).
Step 3: the report still shows asset A; changing the work order's asset did not change it.
Step 5: the report now shows asset B, the work order's current asset.
Step 5: the inspected date is the same as in step 1.
Step 7: the report still shows asset B, as in step 5; the merge did not change it.
=HYPERLINK("https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/88575","C88575")

'Verdict FIX, every correction applied: the asset-edit right is added (step 6 edits a VIN and confirms the merge, which 'Customers - View' alone cannot do); the regenerate control and the role that grants it are left for the build to name, because the spec names neither and no permission is invented; asset C's VIN is a precondition; step 3 now checks only what the report shows (a tester cannot see a version list, and the spec does not say where earlier versions are listed). Divergence to disclose in the case: this rests on Milos Vasic's SV-10960 ruling of 8 Oct, which he said he would add to the PRD; v43 (13 Oct) does not carry it. The merge route (VIN edit, answer Yes) is the one documented on SV-10965 (Stefan Vukovic, 8 Oct, step 9). Shares its source with 'A kept inspection follows its work order's asset at deletion and on merge'.
'A new work order stays, empty, when its drafting is cancelled

'New in the spec: a new work order is created as soon as it is chosen and stays, empty, when drafting is cancelled or the user leaves; nothing is deleted automatically. 'The inspection stays needing action' and 'no build note is written' were already 22 Sep behaviour (a drafted-then-abandoned build leaves the findings unactioned; the note is written only when lines land) and are re-checked here only because they sit in the same flow. The existing cases check cancelling only on the inspection's own work order, never on a new one.
'S15-E7: between 29 Sep 2026 and 2 Oct 2026 (Not named in the change log; written into the PRD by Milos Vasic (PM); Jira SV-10792 (2 Oct 2026) already quotes the new text)

'The shop has ShopCoach and at least one labor type.
You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit', 'Work orders - Create & Edit', 'Customers - View' and 'Work orders - View'.
A completed inspection with a Not OK finding that you completed on this build and that has not been built from, so its row on the asset's Inspections tab offers the build action.

'1. Open the completed inspection.
2. Press Build lines and choose A new work order.
3. Note the new work order's number (for example S1-2301).
4. While the lines are still drafting, press Cancel.
5. Open the new work order's Lines tab and Notes tab.
6. Open the asset's Inspections tab and find the inspection's row.
7. Open the completed inspection again.

'Step 2: the new work order is created at once and you land on its Lines tab.
Step 5: the new work order still exists, with no lines added; it was not deleted.
Step 5: there is no note saying lines were built from the inspection.
Step 6: the row still offers the build action and is counted in 'N of M have findings with no lines yet'.
Step 7: the completed inspection still offers Build lines.
=HYPERLINK("https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/88543","C88543")

'Verdict FIX, every correction applied. The retry step is removed from the manual test: 'a retry runs on the same work order' needs a drafting failure, which cannot be forced by hand, so it needs automation (AUTOMATION: HOLD - drafting failure cannot be forced by hand). why_needed now separates the 22 Sep behaviour from the new part. If the drafting finishes before you can press Cancel, start again with a fresh inspection; the rule also covers leaving the page while drafting runs. Needs a working ShopCoach build flow: run on Staging (the QA environment is blocked for this, SV-11084).
'Drafted lines come from the note, not from the photo

'New since 22 Sep: on 22 Sep photographs reached ShopCoach in the brief; now photos are not sent and the technician's note is the only evidence it reads. No case checks that a photo does not shape the proposed lines.

'S15-N6: between 29 Sep 2026 and 13 Oct 2026 (Not in the change log; written into the PRD by Milos Vasic (PM))
Key Decision: measured values reach ShopCoach in the brief; photos are not sent: between 29 Sep 2026 and 13 Oct 2026 (Not in the change log; replaces the 22 Sep decision 'Measured values and photographs reach ShopCoach in the brief')

'The shop has ShopCoach and at least one labor type.
You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit'.
A template with two checkbox fields (for example Wipers and Lights). On Lights, 'Note required if Monitor / Not OK' is turned off.
An inspection from that template on an open work order, completed with: Wipers answered Not OK, with the note 'Left wiper blade torn' and a photo of something else (for example a cracked mirror); and Lights answered Not OK, with a photo of something distinctive (for example a flat tire) and no note.

'1. Open the completed inspection.
2. Press Build lines and choose This work order.
3. Wait for the proposed lines.
4. Read the proposed line for Wipers.
5. Read the proposed line for Lights.

'Step 4: the Wipers line is about the torn wiper blade from the note; it does not mention the cracked mirror, which is only in the photo.
Step 5: Lights still has a proposed line, and it does not mention the flat tire, which is only in the photo.
=HYPERLINK("https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/88541","C88541")

'Verdict FIX, every correction applied: 'Note required if Monitor / Not OK' is turned off on Lights (it is on by default for new checkbox fields, so otherwise the inspection could not be submitted with no note); the Lights photo now shows something distinctive so the tester can judge the result. This is a falsification check: a line that mentions the mirror or the flat tire proves a photo was read, but a clean result cannot prove the negative on its own. The expectation may move: the S15 status panel in PRD v43 says the Key Decisions on the brief are provisional and that, until the new inspection line builder lands, builds use the existing ShopCoach line builder assistant; the photo decision is one of them. Needs ShopCoach: run on Staging (SV-11084).
